scenes.title: Nobody knew how to build this
scenes.vo: Nobody knew how to build this.
Jørn Utzon won the competition with sketches. For years, nobody could work out how to build the roof.

label.name: The shells
label.meta: Every one cut from the same sphere

scenes.vo: The answer: cut every shell from the same sphere, so the pieces could be made in a factory.

label.name: Inside
label.meta: Timber ribs and stairs under the shells

scenes.vo: Inside, timber ribs climb the walls, right up under the shells.
Utzon left before it opened, and never came back to see it finished.

caption:
The most famous roof in the world started as an impossible sketch.

Every shell of the Sydney Opera House is cut from one sphere — that trick is what made it buildable.
